title: Ghostline
summary: Payment-channel toolkit for agent API calls on Ootle: cumulative off-chain vouchers, HTTP 402 quotes, spending policies, CLI, Rust/TypeScript support and MCP tools. October 21 review found v0.3.2 and a guided local Esmeralda runner that checks the template, starts a sample API, asks before opening and settling, and prints finality links. The documented runner requires walletd 0.47.0 or newer and a funded test wallet; the maintainer reports 0.46.1 decoding failures. The hosted website remains a static motion explainer. Services see requests, prices and vouchers; fees, timing, funding links and channel metadata remain public. Experimental pooled close is not coordinator-private. Esmeralda only; Linux x86-64 CLI releases; MIT. This review read the pinned guide and captured its setup requirements without installing software, using a wallet or sending transactions.
cardSummary: Explore payment channels that let AI agents pay per API call using cumulative vouchers and one settlement.
creator: AduAkorful

recording.credit: Docs walkthrough — Guided Esmeralda setup requirements at v0.3.2; no script or payment executed.
